findings.claim: The learning window is the score-clock interval [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score nodes at 0.01 spacing; the curve support audit reports [0.0, 0.49], so any temporal statement is bounded to this window and no extrapolation is licensed.
The task objective is final predicted target affinity primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; coordinate contrasts are therefore proxies, not affinity measurements.

The observed landmark_00_local_dy curve over score nodes 0.0-0.49 is non-monotone: it starts near zero, dips to about -1.26 z around node 0.05, rises through a positive excursion near node 0.18, and ends near +0.13 z, with 6 sign changes and 4 strong sign conflicts and no accepted polynomial.

For landmark_00, the continuous-trend table reports no accepted polynomial for any of the ten local features (polynomial_accepted=false throughout), with relative_node_RMSE between roughly 0.29 and 0.87 and multiple sign changes (4 to 10) plus strong sign conflicts (1 to 14) per feature.

Landmark_00 rate contrasts are large and sign-reversing between window ends: e.g. landmark_00_local_dy first_rate_z=-72.37 and last_rate_z=+5.52, landmark_00_local_cxy first_rate_z=+64.83 and last_rate_z=-19.67, landmark_00_local_dx first_rate_z=-17.49 and last_rate_z=+8.11, landmark_00_local_cyy first_rate_z=-36.49 and last_rate_z=+17.14. These are changing contrasts, not an absolute coordinate target.

Whole-window mean z for landmark_00 features is small relative to the endpoint rate z values (e.g. landmark_00_soft_mass whole_window_z=0.64, landmark_00_local_cxx whole_window_z=-0.58, landmark_00_local_cyy whole_window_z=-0.58, landmark_00_local_dy whole_window_z=-0.30), indicating the net displacement over the window is weak even where instantaneous rates are large.

hypotheses.direction: test whether early-window observed-forecast relevance and late-window static relevance differ, without reversing the affinity objective
hypotheses.falsifier: if the landmark_00_local_dy curve is statistically indistinguishable across early and late sub-windows at fixed dose, or if its sign-change count collapses under batch resampling, the stage-dependent relevance hypothesis is not supported
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dy observed curve over score nodes 0.0-0.49, with landmark_00_local_dx/local_cxy/local_cyy as corroborating rate contrasts
hypotheses.scope: landmark_00 region, all seeds in the supplied learning window
hypotheses.statement: The observed landmark_00_local_dy curve changes direction within the window (early negative excursion, mid-window positive excursion, near-zero close) rather than following a single monotone trend, so a stage-dependent (time-varying) relevance of the endpoint teacher cloud is a plausible object of test at fixed dose, while a single fixed absolute coordinate target is not supported.

hypotheses.direction: prefer gradual change over a reproducible knot
hypotheses.falsifier: an independently stable profile with a reproducible knot would contradict the gradual-change default
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dy observed curve plus polynomial_accepted, relative_node_RMSE, sign_changes and strong_sign_conflicts for landmark_00 features
hypotheses.statement: Because the observed landmark_00_local_dy curve is non-monotone with 6 sign changes and no accepted polynomial, and the other landmark_00 features likewise show no accepted polynomial with strong sign conflicts, a smooth gradual blend (no data-derived knot) is the appropriate default rather than a sharp stage boundary.

limitations: Stage profiles and temporal profiles are reported unavailable; only continuous curves and summary tables were inspected, so no stage-resolved claim is made.
Only landmark_00 features were read; other landmarks were not queried and remain unobserved rather than absent.
Coordinate contrasts are untyped geometric proxies; no energy, strain or chemical-interaction interpretation is attached to them.
Selection preference and survival are not evidence of final affinity improvement; no decoded final-affinity labels were available in this role input.
